hero_subtitle: One provocation. Twenty minutes. An AI opponent that argues the other side, and a judge that says who held up.
challenge_intro: Take a position on this and an AI opponent will argue against it. You have twenty minutes to file a position, answer its challenge, and take a verdict.
status_initial: No round started yet. Press Enter the Gauntlet — or just file a position below — to start your clock.
objective_1: File a position on today's provocation
objective_2: Send a defence against the opponent's challenge
objective_3: Take the verdict before the clock runs out
position_step_hint: State where you stand on the provocation above. A sentence or two is plenty — the opponent argues against whatever you commit to.
defence_step_hint: Answer the challenge directly. The judge reads the whole round, so take on the strongest point against you rather than restating your position.
rule_1: Read today's provocation and file a position on it. That starts your twenty-minute clock.
rule_2: An AI opponent writes a counter-position and puts one challenge back to you.
rule_3: Answer the challenge. A judge reads the whole round and returns a verdict with its reasons.
rules_footnote: No sign-up and no account. Your text is sent to the debate engine so the opponent and the judge can read it back.
